rationale: The signal concerns whether removing b preserves F under the frozen replay. Even persistence of F establishes only reproduction without b; it does not identify {a,c} as F’s unique internal root cause.

signal_basis.exact_text: Replay {a,c} by removing b from {a,b,c} next under the frozen F oracle: persistence of F eliminates b from the required subset, while disappearance of F retains b as required in that configuration.
A retained minimal configuration demonstrates reproducibility under the test, not necessarily the unique underlying causal mechanism.
